verdict.rationale: Devin documents recurring background automation through scheduled sessions with cron expressions, one-time scheduling, notification preferences, and agent selection. It also documents event-driven automation: Devin Review with Auto-Fix responds to review comments and CI failures on its own, and longer tasks can be handed off to cloud Devin. Missing for 10: a dedicated first-party scheduling/automations guide (schedules are evidenced only through the Devin MCP tool descriptions), detail on monitoring and managing running automations, and independent or hands-on corroboration that schedules run reliably.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background
